metadata.title: An isoperimetric characterization of a new ADM-like mass for $C^0$-asymptotically flat manifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove that the notion of mass recently introduced by Mazurowski and Yao for continuous metrics coincides with Huisken's isoperimetric mass on smooth Riemannian $3$-manifolds with nonnegative scalar curvature whose metric has sharp $C^0$-asymptotically flat behavior. As a consequence, we deduce a Riemannian Penrose inequality for the mass parameter of asymptotically Schwarzschildian $3$-manifolds.

analysis.workSummary: 证明 Mazurowski--Yao 为连续度量定义的质量，在具有尖锐 $C^0$ 渐近平坦行为的光滑非负标量曲率三流形上等于 Huisken 等周质量。
analysis.breakthrough: 由此把新质量参数接入经典几何，并导出相应的 Riemannian Penrose 不等式。
analysis.limitations: 等价结论仍要求光滑性、非负标量曲率和尖锐 $C^0$ 渐近；更低正则情形未完全覆盖。
